MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. Solve for x: x + 8 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 13
   C. 8
   D. 12

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

17. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

18. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 1

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

21. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 32

25. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

26. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

27. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 20

28. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

29. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

30. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
